approach_summary: Build the Quick-react bar as a self-contained feature module at src/features/quickReact/, gated by a new GrowthBook flag 'quick_reactions_v0' (default OFF, runtime-flippable). v0 storage is client-only MMKV on the account-scoped Storage instance (src/storage/index.ts account store); cross-device persistence is deferred to v1 by abstracting all reads/writes behind TanStack Query hooks so the backend can swap without touching components. Composition: QuickReactBarTrigger wraps post body in PostFeedItem and thread post components; on native it opens QuickReactBar (overlay pill) via LongPressGestureHandler >=400ms; on web it exposes QuickReactButton (hover >=200ms reveal) which opens QuickReactPopover. A shared QuickReactPicker (Dialog) is the a11y entry point for the 'react' accessibility action. QuickReactChip renders inline in PostControls when a reaction exists. A feature-level context holds a postUri-keyed trailing-2s-debounce scheduler that performs optimistic updates (sync MMKV write + TanStack setQueryData), flushes final selection to the mutation, and reverts + shows a Toast on failure (no retry). Analytics emits three events (quickReaction:barOpen/select/remove) with SHA-256-truncated postUri hash. Platform files use the directory + index.platform.tsx pattern; stub files are provided for platforms that render nothing.

steps.description: Define types, constants, and emoji set. Create ReactionEmoji union ('heart' | 'fire' | 'eyes' | 'joy'), ReactionRecord, ReactionsMap, surface enum, and constants (FLAG_NAME, LONG_PRESS_MS=400, HOVER_REVEAL_MS=200, HOVER_HIDE_MS=150, DEBOUNCE_MS=2000, MAX_RECORDS=500, PRUNE_COUNT=100). Add a storage schema extension: augment src/storage/schema.ts Account type with optional `quickReactions?: {version: 1, reactions: ReactionsMap, lastPrunedAt?: number}`. Add flag enum entry `QuickReactionsV0 = 'quick_reactions_v0'` in src/analytics/features/types.ts. Register three analytics events in src/analytics/metrics/types.ts: 'quickReaction:barOpen', 'quickReaction:select', 'quickReaction:remove'.

Implement storage module (src/features/quickReact/storage.ts) wrapping the account-scoped MMKV Storage instance from src/storage/index.ts. Export readAccountReactions(did), writeAccountReaction(did, record), deleteAccountReaction(did, postUri), and subscribeToReactions(did, cb). Implement 500-record cap with oldest-100 eviction by updatedAt on write. Handle missing/corrupt records defensively (return empty map).

Implement analytics module (src/features/quickReact/analytics.ts). hashPostUri(uri) using expo-crypto (verify availability; fallback to @noble/hashes/sha2 pure-JS) returning first 16 hex chars of SHA-256. Export logBarOpen(payload), logSelect(payload), logRemove(payload) that construct full event payloads (uriHash, emoji, surface, entryPoint, flagVariant, logContext, isChange/previousEmoji/removalMethod) and emit via the existing analytics context (src/analytics/index.tsx ax.metric). Payloads never contain raw postUri.

Implement feature flag and session gate hook (src/features/quickReact/hooks/useQuickReactsEnabled.ts). Returns true only when useSession().hasSession === true AND useAnalytics().features.enabled(Features.QuickReactionsV0). Must be callable at the very top of every entry component so downstream hooks (queries, analytics) never execute when false. Also implement useReducedMotion.ts (thin wrapper over react-native-reanimated's useReducedMotion for parity with existing src/lib/custom-animations/LikeIcon.tsx usage).

Implement TanStack Query layer (src/features/quickReact/queries/reactions.ts) and useViewerReaction hook (src/features/quickReact/hooks/useViewerReaction.ts). createViewerReactionsQueryKey({did}) factory via createQueryKey from src/state/queries/util.ts. useViewerReactionsQuery: queryFn reads from MMKV (synchronous via readAccountReactions), staleTime STALE.INFINITY. useViewerReaction({postUri}): wraps useViewerReactionsQuery with select: map => map[postUri]. useWriteReactionMutation: mutationFn currently no-ops on network (v0 is client-only) but is the abstraction point for v1 server swap; onError returns pre-change record for revert.

Implement feature context and debounced write controller (src/features/quickReact/context.tsx). Provider holds a Map<postUri, {timer, lastKnown, pending}> scheduler. schedule(postUri, emojiOrNull): (1) capture lastKnown from MMKV if not already captured; (2) synchronously write new value to MMKV + queryClient.setQueryData (optimistic, <100ms to meet AC-16); (3) clearTimeout + setTimeout(flush, 2000) trailing debounce per AC-17; (4) emit analytics select/remove. flush fires useWriteReactionMutation; onError reverts MMKV + query cache + shows Toast.show({type: 'warning', content: _(msg`Couldn't save reaction`)}). cancel(postUri) on post delete / sign-out. AppState listener flushes on background. Exposes useQuickReactController() hook.

Mount QuickReactProvider at the app root in src/App.native.tsx and src/App.web.tsx so the scheduler survives screen navigation and the flush-on-background handler is global. Placement: inside session/query-client providers but above route tree.

Build QuickReactPicker (src/features/quickReact/components/QuickReactPicker/index.tsx) — a11y-first shared Dialog.Outer + Dialog.ScrollableInner picker. Header with Dialog.HeaderText _(msg`React to post`). Body: four emoji rows (heart/fire/eyes/joy) each with localized label via Lingui msg() (AC-13). When currentEmoji present: show selected-state styling + accessibilityState.selected=true + add 'Remove reaction' row. Selection path uses control.close(() => onSelect(emoji)) callback form (CLAUDE.md footgun). Dialog.Handle on native, Dialog.Close on web. No hex colors; ALF atoms + theme tokens only.

Build QuickReactChip platform files. index.tsx (native): useQuickReactsEnabled gate; useViewerReaction read; if no emoji return null; render pill with emoji at configured size, theme-tinted bg (t.palette.primary_25 / primary_975), 44pt minimum hit region; Pressable opens the bar; long-press also opens bar. accessibilityLabel localized via msg(). Reduced-motion branch for entrance/exit animation. index.web.tsx: same logic but click opens popover via context; keyboard Enter/Space supported. RTL mirroring via a.flex_row inside an already-mirrored parent.

Build QuickReactBar platform files. index.tsx (native): react-native-reanimated overlay pill rendered at an anchor point; entrance/exit per UX §2.3 with reduced-motion branch (opacity only); pre-highlights currentEmoji; calls useHaptics()('Light') on select (AC-5); four emoji tap targets 44x44; handles edge collision (flip above/below touch point, clamp horizontally). Emits analytics barOpen at mount. index.web.tsx: stub returning null (web uses popover).

Build QuickReactPopover platform files. index.web.tsx: popover anchored to a passed ref; focus trap; focus on first emoji on open (AC-7); arrow key navigation (mirrored in RTL); Enter/Space selects; Escape closes and restores focus; outside-click dismisses (AC-6). Reduced-motion branch via @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). Emits analytics barOpen at mount. index.tsx: stub returning null (native uses bar).

Build QuickReactButton platform files. index.web.tsx: web React button rendered at leading edge of PostControls row; Button primitive with Emoji icon; visible after 200ms hover or always when @media (hover: none); Tab-focusable; Enter/Space opens popover with focus on first emoji. index.tsx: stub returning null.

Build QuickReactBarTrigger platform files. index.tsx (native): wraps children with LongPressGestureHandler, minDurationMs=400, simultaneousHandlers configured with parent ScrollView pan; cancels if vertical movement >8pt before 400ms; on activation captures touch point and opens QuickReactBar; release on emoji = select, off-target = dismiss (AC-4). Children pass through for existing tap behavior. Gated via useQuickReactsEnabled — OFF renders children only. index.web.tsx: renders children + QuickReactButton with hover-intent state machine (200ms reveal, 150ms hide); touch-web (@media (hover: none)) keeps button always visible. Gated via useQuickReactsEnabled.

Build QuickReactA11yAction helper (src/features/quickReact/components/QuickReactA11yAction.ts). Returns { accessibilityActions: [{name: 'react', label: _(msg`React to post`)}], onAccessibilityAction } for use by post row wrappers. Handler opens the Dialog control for QuickReactPicker. Helper short-circuits to returning no action when useQuickReactsEnabled is false (AC-15).

Create the feature barrel export (src/features/quickReact/index.ts) re-exporting QuickReactBarTrigger, QuickReactChip, QuickReactPicker, QuickReactA11yAction helper, useQuickReactsEnabled, and QuickReactProvider. Consumers import only from '#/features/quickReact'.

Integrate into PostControls (src/components/PostControls/index.tsx). Add optional `surface?: 'feed' | 'thread'` prop (default undefined = inert). When surface is set and flag enabled: render <QuickReactChip postUri surface /> between the Like block and Bookmark/Share block; on web render <QuickReactButton postUri surface /> at leading edge. Zero render footprint when surface undefined or flag OFF (AC-15). Existing Like/Reply/Repost/Bookmark/Share unchanged (AC-3).

Wire PostFeedItem (src/view/com/posts/PostFeedItem.tsx): import QuickReactBarTrigger, wrap the post body subtree (author block + text content, EXCLUDING embeds/avatar/link cards to resolve R2 gesture conflicts); pass surface='feed' to PostControls; attach accessibilityActions from QuickReactA11yAction helper to the post row wrapper; mount the Dialog control for QuickReactPicker. No changes when flag is OFF.

Wire the three thread post components (src/screens/PostThread/components/ThreadItemAnchor.tsx, ThreadItemPost.tsx, ThreadItemTreePost.tsx) identically to PostFeedItem but with surface='thread'. Attach QuickReactBarTrigger around post body and a11y action on the row wrapper.

e2e_tests.description: Tab to React button; Enter opens popover with focus on first emoji; arrow keys move focus (mirrored in RTL); Enter selects; Escape closes and restores focus

e2e_tests.description: With quick_reactions_v0 OFF, long-press does nothing new, React button absent, a11y action absent, no chip rendered even if a record exists locally, no network/analytics call observed

e2e_tests.name: offline failure path
e2e_tests.description: Select emoji while offline; chip appears optimistically; after debounce flush, chip reverts and 'Couldn't save reaction' toast appears; no retry observed

e2e_tests.name: debounce coalesces
e2e_tests.description: Rapid-fire select heart, fire, eyes within 2s on same post; only one mutation fires with final emoji 'eyes'

smoke_checks: typecheck clean across all new files
lint clean (no raw hex colors, no hard-coded English strings in new feature files)
app boots on iOS, Android, web with flag OFF and shows no regression in PostFeedItem/PostControls
app boots with flag forced ON in dev and shows the chip/button path
QuickReactProvider mounted exactly once at app root
no new top-level src/ directories introduced

risks.risk: Flag checked too late — useQuery or analytics call fires before useQuickReactsEnabled() gate, leaking network/analytics when flag is OFF (violates AC-15)
risks.mitigation: Every entry component's first line is `if (!enabled) return null`. Hooks below the gate never run. Code-review checklist + useQuickReactsEnabled.test.ts asserts zero side effects in OFF state.

risks.risk: Native gesture conflict — LongPressGestureHandler overlaps with existing feed scroll, image viewer, link cards, author-avatar navigation
risks.mitigation: Wrap only a sub-container inside PostFeedItem that excludes embeds, avatar link, and link preview; configure simultaneousHandlers with parent ScrollView's pan; cancel on >8pt vertical movement before 400ms. Explicit integration test.

risks.risk: Debounce + optimistic + rapid-change race — final selection must win, chip must reflect latest, mutation must carry final emoji
risks.mitigation: Single centralized scheduler in context.tsx; all writes funnel through schedule(); lastKnown captured once per debounce window; unit tests with fake timers cover three-selection scenarios and failure revert.

risks.risk: Cross-device persistence gap — AC-9 language says 'across devices' but atproto is out of scope; v0 is device-local only
risks.mitigation: Parent agent resolved to client-only MMKV. Query/mutation abstraction in queries/reactions.ts lets v1 swap to a server backend without touching components. Documented in ADR.

risks.risk: Touch-capable web browsers have unreliable hover; AC-6 hover-reveal excludes them
risks.mitigation: When @media (hover: none) matches, React button is always rendered (no hover gate). Documented in UX §4.2 and implemented in QuickReactBarTrigger/index.web.tsx.

risks.risk: accessibilityActions may not currently exist on PostFeedItem row wrapper; attaching the 'react' action requires surgery
risks.mitigation: S17 step explicitly adds accessibilityActions to the outer Link/View of the PostFeedItem row; QuickReactA11yAction helper encapsulates the action object and handler to keep PostFeedItem diff minimal.

risks.risk: Analytics PII leak — raw postUri contains author DID
risks.mitigation: hashPostUri (SHA-256 truncated to 16 hex) used for all analytics payloads; analytics.test.ts asserts raw URI never appears in emitted events.

risks.risk: Platform stub files missing — bundler may error on web when importing native-only component or vice versa
risks.mitigation: Every branching component ships both index.tsx and index.web.tsx; platforms that render nothing export a typed stub returning null.

risks.risk: expo-crypto may not be installed; adding a native dep is undesirable late in plan
risks.mitigation: Verify at S3; fallback to pure-JS SHA-256 via @noble/hashes/sha2 (zero native dep).

risks.risk: MMKV 500-record cap may be insufficient for heavy reactors
risks.mitigation: Monitor via analytics barOpen/select counts; tune cap in v1. Documented in requirements §3.4.

out_of_scope: atproto lexicon, federation, firehose integration for reactions
Cross-device sync (downgraded to same-device-cross-restart in v0)
Author notifications on receiving a reaction
Custom emoji set or skin tones (fixed {heart, fire, eyes, joy})
Long-press on web (web uses hover + click)
Like button refactor or merge with reactions
Reactions in composer or reply flow
Reactions on DMs, profiles, lists, feed generators
Reactions on quote embeds, search result previews, notification items, feed-generator previews
Retry loop on failed reaction write
